issuer: the Idaho Transportation Department, Division of Motor Vehicles
note: ITD's licence page (read 2026-10-30) gives the operator (Class D) licence, 21 and over, for 4 years at $35.00, and, ages 21 to 62, for 8 years at $60.00, and says a standard renewal is valid for either four years or eight years: both are held as terms the holder chooses, from 21, the youngest age they are issued at (younger drivers get 1- and 3-year licences, shorter ones, not held). The ID card page gives a card, 21 and over, for 4 years at $15.00 or 8 years at $25.00, both held as terms. No youngest age for the card was read (cards are sold under 18). On 2026-10-30 the file was rewritten with the terms the holder chooses among: until then it held the 8-year licence at $60.00 and the 8-year card at $25.00 only, and the 4-year licence and card were added from the same pages. Later on 2026-10-30 the ages each term is sold to were added from the same pages: the 4-year licence from 21, the 8-year licence from 21 to 62 (under 63), and both cards from 21 (the page sells them to 21 and over; a card under 21 wasn't read, so a holder under 21 has no card term here).

sources.said: 4-Year License (age 21 and over) $35.00 8-Year License (age 21 to 62) $60.00 ... A standard (Class D) driver’s license renewal is valid for either four years or eight years.
